questions.question: When David heard the Philistines were attacking the town of Keilah, what did he do first?
Day after day, King Saul searched the wilderness for David. Why did Saul not catch him during those searches?

answers.text: God would not hand David over

questions.question: Saul's son Jonathan told David not to be afraid. What did Jonathan say David would become over Israel?
While King Saul and his men were closing in to capture David in the wilderness, what happened?

answers.text: A messenger brought news of a raid
David's men turned and fought back
A storm stopped Saul's whole army
